swaths.name: Smiley
swaths.why: The radar swath across the west-central farm belt on the day Municipal Hail counted as its worst of 2023 (25 July: $11.4 million in crop claims, most in the RMs of Oakdale and Kindersley).

swaths.name: Webb
swaths.why: The radar swath west of Swift Current on 22 July 2023, when Municipal Hail recorded a storm that began northwest of Swift Current ($8.3 million in crop claims along its whole track).

swaths.name: Estevan
swaths.why: The longest radar swath of 2024, across the southeast on 23 June 2024, when Municipal Hail counted hail in 76 rural municipalities.
